snippet.title: Animula Nook | Alpha Test Official Trailer | Coming March 19!
snippet.description:
March 19 is almost here. Animula Nook’s Alpha Test is just around the corner.
Haven’t signed up yet? There’s still time. Alpha Test sign-ups close on: March 15, 10:00 (UTC+0)
📝 SIGN UP FOR ALPHA TEST: https://animulanook.com/en/ (Log in and complete the survey to secure your spot!)
🎮 WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3767320/Animula_Nook/
---
The Wubus is almost at the station. So… what is life in Minietopia really like?
On March 19, you’ll finally be able to step off the bus and see for yourself.
We’ll be waiting for you in Minietopia.
#AnimulaNookAlphaTest #AnimulaNook #ComeMakeItHome #MinietopiaArrivalCard
---
And one more thing.
Starside intern Dilly has been busy preparing Minietopia Arrival Cards (https://animulanook.com/events/a20250205sc/en/) for everyone.
Create your own personalized arrival card and get ready for your journey.
We can’t wait to welcome you home.୧(๑•̀◡•́๑)૭
---
[Stay Connected]
Follow us on X and Discord for the latest updates, community events, giveaways, and surprise test access drops.
🎮 Discord (Show Your Minietopia Arrival Card to Win Test Access!): https://discord.gg/animulanook
🐦 X (Show Your Minietopia Arrival Card to Win More!): https://x.com/Animula_Nook
---
*Please note: Animula Nook is currently in development. This Alpha Test does not represent the final quality of the game.
